items.title: AI in Australia—OpenAI’s Economic Blueprint
items.summary: Today, OpenAI, in partnership with Mandala Partners, is sharing the OpenAI AI Economic Blueprint for Australia. At a time when boosting productivity has emerged as a national priority for Australia, the Blueprint provides a clear, actionable plan for how Australia can unlock the full economic and social potential of artificial intelligence.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于澳大利亚AI经济发展的蓝图报告，主要探讨AI对生产力的提升作用及政策建议，属于宏观战略层面的讨论，不涉及具体模型技术。
